intro: Nak's Skull is a grisly hunting trophy severed from Nak, one of three prominent Razormane quilboar commanders directing warbands in the southern Barrens. Taken as proof of the raider's defeat, it is sought by the captive quilboar Mangletooth to avenge a bitter tribal betrayal.

p: Emerging from Razorfen Kraul, the trio consisting of Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane launched vicious raids targeting Horde settlements and roadways across the Barrens. Unknown to the defenders at the Crossroads, these warlords were orchestrating attacks far more cunning than typical tribal skirmishing. When the Razormane prisoner Mangletooth was abandoned to die in a cage at Camp Taurajo, his thirst for retribution turned against his former brethren. Demanding physical proof of Nak's demise, Mangletooth asks Horde adventurers to deliver the severed skull alongside those of his cohorts to break the back of the southern raiding parties.
